slide_out.name: a8R service 'replace / re-seat load cell R (fin off the tray)' on the chair: with the cover and the three M4 x 20 out, the whole right handle (fin halves, cartridge, piston, grip) comes off the tray end wall outboard (+x); the lead is unplugged and drawn back through the end-wall hole (ignored). No row covered this path. Bench props (cradle, jack) at x 400 ignored
a8R end stop: the handle cannot lift straight up on the chair (the back plate's slot lip holds the fin), so the service path is outboard only; README 'cartridge comes out of the fin' should say so

stacks.name: a8R rear printed washer (Ø13 x 2.4, printed flat) bridging the 5.5 mm stud slot at 1.2 x FS pull (589 N): nut bearing over the slot (28 % of the M5 nut annulus, 165 N) carried across the 5.5 slot by the washer's own ring, OD/2 - 2.65 = 3.85 wide (the designer's row uses 6.05, wider than the ring), clamped ends (simply supported gives 30.7). MPa in the layer plane; limit 20. cad/review/a8/scripts/head_a8.py 9

a8R README claim 'a full pull plus a 100 N lean still clears the saddle', at one consistent modulus (E 2500): pull pitch at the catch 0.0859 + 100 N x 7.50e-4 mm/N; limit catch_c. The designer's 104.6 N margin takes the pitch at E 3000 and the lean at E 2500. head_a8.py 2

a8R piston at the 45 deg step to the Ø22.2 spigot (y 141), 600 N lean: nominal 45.6 MPa x Kt 1.4 (D/d 1.08, 45 deg chamfer, no fillet); the designer's row checks the nominal only; limit 76/1.6. head_a8.py 7

a8R piston at the socket mouth, 600 N lean, printed with slicer defaults (2 walls 0.42, 15 % infill at ~0.1 E: I_eff 5224 vs 15358 solid). No README, BOM, plates.txt or 3MF setting asks for more; limit 76/1.6. head_a8.py 7

a8R catch saddle across the layers at a 600 N lean (738 N, point, clamped over the 15 mm gap), printed with slicer defaults (2 walls, 15 %): I 276 vs 383 solid; limit 15 (the designer's own). head_a8.py 6

a8R right amp's Qwiic jumper: README step 6 plugs it into the ESP32 in tray L on the bench, then step 10 hangs the two halves separately. Its route needs 142.8 of the 150 mm (cables row); limit 150 with 20 mm to handle a tethered half
